from .masker import LoggerWrapper  # Ensure masker.py is in the same package
import datetime

def setup_logger(log_file='app.log', max_bytes=1024*1024*5, backup_count=5):
    logger = LoggerWrapper()
    handler = RotatingFileHandler(log_file, maxBytes=max_bytes, backupCount=backup_count)
    formatter = logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(event)s - %(message)s', datefmt='%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    handler.setFormatter(formatter)
    logger.addHandler(handler)
    return logger

def log_message(logger, level, message, phone=None):
    timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    record = logging.LogRecord(
        name=logger.name,
        level=logging._convert(level),  # Ensure level is correctly converted
        pathname='', lineno=None,
        msg=message,
        args=[], exc_info=None,
        extra={}
    )
    if phone:

        record.kwargs['phone'] = masked_phone
    else:
        record.kwargs['phone'] = None
    record.created = datetime.datetime.now()
    record.levelname = logging.getLevelName(level)
    record.timestamp = timestamp
    logger.handle(record)
